description_en: Queries a list of pipeline jobs. Filtering, sorting, and pagination are supported for this API operation
description_zh: 获取工作流任务列表，支持过滤、排序和分页查询
kebab_example: aliyun paiflow list-pipeline-runs --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source-id ybpy0000000000fb2z --name testName --order DESC --source-type UNKNOWN --status Succeeded --workspace-id 104623 --user-id 1550000000000904 --pipeline-ids flow-rer700000000000otv,_flow-hynm0000000000sfef --sort-by PipelineId --pipeline-run-id flow-14vioac3k1s07k0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPipelineRuns

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的工作流任务数量，默认为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline job source. You can view the ID of the pipeline job source on the pipeline details page. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480625.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务来源ID。请在工作流详情页面查看工作流任务来源ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480625.html
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the pipeline job
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. You must specify this parameter together with the SortBy parameter. Valid values:

ASC: ascending order.
DESC: descending order. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
排序的顺序，取值如下，与SortBy一起使用。
ASC：升序。
DESC（默认值）：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The type of the pipeline job source. Valid values:

UNKNOWN: If you do not specify this parameter, UNKNOWN is used as the default value.
SDK: The pipeline job is created by using an SDK.
DESIGNER: The pipeline job is created by using Machine Learning Designer.
M6: The pipeline job is created on other websites
parameters.help_zh:
工作流任务来源类型，支持如下值：
UNKNOWN（默认）：未指定来源类型时的默认值。
SDK：通过SDK创建的工作流任务。
DESIGNER：通过Designer创建的工作流任务。
M6：通过其他网站创建的工作流任务
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the pipeline jobs to be filtered. Valid values:

Initialized
Running
Succeeded
Failed
Terminated
Unknown
Skipped
Terminating
parameters.help_zh:
需要过滤的工作流任务的状态，目前有如下几种状态：

Initialized
Running
Succeeded
Failed
Terminated
Unknown
Skipped
Terminating
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the pipelines. Multiple pipeline IDs are separated by commas (,). You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438051.html to obtain the ID of the pipeline
parameters.help_zh: 工作流的ID集合，多个工作流ID使用半角逗号（,）分隔。如何获取工作流ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438051.html
parameters.name: pipeline_ids

parameters.help_en:
The field for sorting. Valid values:

PipelineId
UserId
ParentUserId
StartedAt
FinishedAt
WorkflowServiceId
Duration
GmtCreateTime
GmtModifiedTime
parameters.help_zh:
用于排序的字段。目前有如下字段支持用于排序：

PipelineId
UserId
ParentUserId
StartedAt
FinishedAt
WorkflowServiceId
Duration
GmtCreateTime
GmtModifiedTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The pipeline job ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the ID of the pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务ID，如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: pipeline_run_id
